projects.title: SDET Automation Framework
projects.meta: Personal open-source project · Python · GitHub Actions
projects.summary: A production-style automation framework spanning a storefront, an online bank, two REST APIs and a security suite, built the way I build them for banking clients, with a published release-readiness report.
bullets: BDD scenarios (pytest-bdd) over Selenium page objects; storefront and ParaBank banking (UI + REST).
API breadth: restful-booker contracts (JSON Schema) and the YouTube Data API.
OWASP-aligned security suite: SQL injection, XSS, broken access control and security headers, with OWASP Juice Shop as a known-vulnerable reference target.
Order totals verified to the cent; CI on every change and nightly; screenshots kept as evidence.
Readiness report with a security gate and a Go / No-go recommendation; 62 tests, 6 findings logged.
